description: Starter Critical User Journeys for small-business client sites. Pulled in as unapproved drafts by `guardrails init --preset small-business`; a human edits, links specs and approves them.

journeys.title: Visitor lands on the home page and finds the service they need
steps: Open the home page
See what the business does within the first screen
Open the services list
Open one service and read price or next step

journeys.title: Visitor sends an enquiry through the contact form and sees a confirmation
steps: Open the contact page from the main navigation
Fill in name, email and message
Submit the form
See a clear confirmation; the business receives the enquiry

journeys.title: Visitor books an appointment or taps to call from any page
steps: Find the book or call button in the header
Tap call (tel: link) or open booking
Pick a time and confirm
See the booking confirmation

journeys.title: Visitor reads about the business, reviews and credentials before deciding
steps: Open About from the navigation
Read who runs the business and how long it has operated
See reviews or testimonials
Find a way to get in touch from the page

journeys.title: Visitor completes the main journey on a phone without zooming or broken layout
steps: Open the site at a 390px wide viewport
Open the menu and navigate to services
Use the call or contact button
Nothing overflows horizontally and tap targets are usable

journeys.title: Visitor finds the address, map and opening hours
steps: Find the address and hours from the footer or contact page
Open the map link
See today's hours

journeys.title: Visitor browses the menu with prices
steps: Open the menu page
Browse sections
See item names, descriptions and prices

journeys.title: Visitor orders online and gets an order confirmation
steps: Add an item to the order
Open the cart and adjust quantity
Check out with contact and pickup or delivery details
See the order confirmation

journeys.title: Visitor browses the gallery of past work
steps: Open the gallery
Open an image full size
Move to the next image and close
